scientific_limitations: Double reproduction threshold and marginal-competition equality only; deterministic eight-compartment homogeneous vital-dynamics system; both strains initially present. No conclusions for stochastic finite populations or generic off-surface parameters.
title: A logarithmic extinction hierarchy at the double-critical two-strain epidemic threshold
